translations.web: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.
translations.bsb: While He was reclining at the table with them, He took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when he had sat down with them to meat, he took the bread and blessed; and breaking it he gave to them.
